meta.what: One canonical page per X post: the slug and the headline. Hand-written, because a slug cut out of a tweet is `jev-will-make-agents-10-x-faster-and-cheaper-her` and a headline cut out of one is a truncation.
meta.why: The reference site links every card to an internal record. Ours linked out to X, which made the hub a doorway: a reader who left rarely came back, and nothing on the site accumulated the link.
meta.rule: The slug describes the subject of the post, not the author or the date. The headline is a sentence we can stand behind: where the post makes an unverified claim, the headline says it is a claim (the '10x' routing claim, the 'up to 193x' figure), not a fact.
